settings.markdown:
## What we ask
- A gear setup you're happy to bring, and the will to learn
- Discord with a working microphone for raids
- Show up when you sign up, and tell us when you can't

## What you get
- Teaching trips for every raid and most group bosses
- Split loot, and a collection log that remembers your best day
- People to kill things with at any hour

items.q: I've never raided. Can I still join?
items.a: Yes. Say so in the Discord and you'll be on the next teaching trip.
Always, unless the team agrees otherwise before the kill.
